instruction: A photoreal cast-iron anvil with a tapered horn, hardy hole, and a scarred flat face pitted from years of hammering. Rough dark forge-scale coats the body while the polished working surface shows metallic wear and faint rust bleeding down the waisted base.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Blacksmith Anvil in a realistic style. A photoreal cast-iron anvil with a tapered horn, hardy hole, and a scarred flat face pitted from years of hammering. Rough dark forge-scale coats the body while the polished working surface shows metallic wear and faint rust bleeding down the waisted base. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
